title: AdvancedSettings
description: The only Settings plugin you will ever need!
body:
AdvancedSettings is a lightweight per-player quality-of-life plugin that lets each player customize their own gameplay experience without affecting others. Toggle permanent night vision, suppress hostile mob and phantom spawning around you, and enable a confirm-before-drop system to prevent accidental item loss — all saved automatically to a SQLite database so your preferences persist through restarts and relogs.

### WARNING
Please use [1.0.1](https://modrinth.com/plugin/advancedsettings/version/8dOKuyzK) for phantoms, confirm drop items, and a full release
